name: DataNap — vault your tabs & deep-sleep the rest
summary: Vault open tabs to a local list you can reopen, and deep-sleep idle tabs to free RAM. 100% local. A OneTab-style tab manager.
metaDescription: Vault open tabs to a local list you can reopen, and deep-sleep idle tabs to free RAM. 100% local. A OneTab-style tab manager.
